# Expense Claim Approvals and Audit Log: Feature Specification

## 1. Document Status

- Run ID: 20261012-004104-3d33dd
- Date: 2026-10-12
- Run mode: fixture
- Publication status: pending final pass
- Known limitations: The mockup capture is complete (2 pages) but shows only one default row per screen and no empty, loading, error or success states. Research ran in fixture mode against two recorded sources that describe themselves as test fixtures, not real documentation; every kept finding has low confidence. No WCAG, OWASP, ISO 27001 or HMRC source could be fetched. Research was run only for the two gaps approved for research. Customer answers in this run are pre-written evaluation answers from a case file, not live customer replies. Review has not yet taken place.
- Open stale items: none
- Unresolved blocking issues: five blocking customer questions are unanswered (Q-001, Q-002, Q-003, Q-005, Q-006, see section 16); REQ-002 carries the label Unknown (audit entry contents, retention and viewing permissions undecided).

## 2. Executive Summary

Managers need to approve or reject expense claims, every approval and rejection must be written to an audit log, and finance staff need to export that log. The customer has confirmed that managers act only on claims from their own direct reports, that a reason is required when a claim is rejected, and that the export is a CSV file of audit log entries.

This specification covers three areas: approving and rejecting claims, the audit log, and the CSV export. Several important points are still undecided and need customer answers before they can be built: what happens to claims from managers or when a manager is away, who may view the audit log, what each log entry must contain, whether log entries may ever be changed, how long they are kept, and where reporting lines are held. Many other gaps were deferred by decision and are listed under Deferred. The research that was done rests on weak test-fixture sources, so research-based items are shown as recommendations and not as confirmed requirements.

## 3. Goals and Scope

### Goals

- Let managers approve or reject expense claims from their own direct reports. [Customer: REQ-001 · Approved: DEC-001] [Decision: DEC-001]
- Record every approval and rejection in an audit log. [Customer: FEA-008 · Explicit] [Customer: REQ-002]
- Let finance staff export the audit log as a CSV file. [Customer: REQ-003 · Approved: DEC-003] [Decision: DEC-003]

### In Scope

- Approve and Reject actions limited to direct reports' claims. [Customer: FEA-001 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-001]
- A mandatory reason when rejecting a claim. [Customer: FEA-005 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-002]
- Audit log entries for approvals and rejections. [Customer: FEA-008 · Explicit]
- CSV export of audit log entries by finance staff. [Customer: FEA-013 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-003]
- Handling of the reject reason and the audit log contents is in scope as open design questions (GAP-001, GAP-002 approved by DEC-004), and the direct-reports edge cases and employee notification (GAP-004, GAP-013 approved by DEC-005) are in scope as open customer questions; their answers are not yet decided.

### Out of Scope / Rejected

No item has been rejected and no REQ was excluded by the customer. Information unavailable: no decision in this run records a rejection. Exclusions are not inferred from absence in the mockup.

### Deferred

Deferred by DEC-005 (research for these gaps was not run). Each is listed with its label; none is specified in this document.

- GAP-003 Outcome of Approve and Reject not defined. Label: Deferred: DEC-005
- GAP-005 Reversal or correction of a decision. Label: Deferred: DEC-005
- GAP-006 Who may view the audit log, and whether roles other than finance may export. Label: Deferred: DEC-005
- GAP-007 Export scope, columns and failure behaviour. Label: Deferred: DEC-005
- GAP-008 Spreadsheet formula injection through exported CSV. Label: Deferred: DEC-005
- GAP-009 Duplicate and concurrent decisions on the same claim. Label: Deferred: DEC-005
- GAP-010 Accessible names and feedback for row actions. Label: Deferred: DEC-005
- GAP-011 Empty, loading and error states for both screens. Label: Deferred: DEC-005
- GAP-012 Volume handling in claims list and audit log. Label: Deferred: DEC-005
- GAP-014 Time zone and date format of audit timestamps. Label: Deferred: DEC-005
- GAP-015 Navigation back from the Audit log. Label: Deferred: DEC-005

## 4. Users and Roles

- Manager: approves or rejects claims from their own direct reports only. [Customer: REQ-001 · Approved: DEC-001] [Decision: DEC-001]
- Finance staff: can export the audit log. [Customer: REQ-003 · Approved: DEC-003]
- Employee: submits the claims shown (for example Kim Lee in the mockup). Whether employees are notified of outcomes is undecided. [Inferred: FEA-014 · Unknown]
- Roles that may view the audit log, roles other than finance that may export, and any administrator, delegate or override role are unknown and flagged as open questions (section 16). [Inferred: FEA-002 · Unknown]
- Who approves a manager's own claim or a top-level employee's claim is unknown. [Inferred: FEA-002 · Unknown]

## 5. Existing Mockup Coverage

Capture status: complete, 2 pages captured, 0 failed, fixture mode.

- Screen "Expense approvals": table of claims (Claim, Employee, Amount) with Approve and Reject buttons per row and an Audit log link; default state shows one row (EXP-77 Train to Leeds, Kim Lee, £86.40). [Mockup: SCR-001 · Observed]
- Claims table has an unlabelled actions column; Approve and Reject buttons are not visibly disabled. [Mockup: SCR-003 · Observed]
- Audit log link on the approvals screen leads to the Audit log screen. [Mockup: SCR-004 · Observed] [Mockup: SCR-007]
- Screen "Audit log": table (When, Who, Action) and Export CSV button; default state shows one entry (2 Mar 10:14, J. Smith, Approved EXP-71). [Mockup: SCR-002 · Observed]
- Audit log table and Export CSV button. [Mockup: SCR-005 · Observed] [Mockup: SCR-006]
- Approve, Reject and Export CSV have no link or target in the capture, so their outcomes are not shown. [Mockup: SCR-008 · Observed] [Mockup: SCR-009] [Mockup: SCR-010]
- Ambiguous behaviours recorded: who may act, approval limits, undo, reason and confirmation step, result after action, failure, notification or payment (on the claims table); who may export and export contents (on Export CSV); who may view, which actions are logged, sorting and retention (on the audit table). [Mockup: SCR-003 · Observed]
- No year or time zone is shown in the audit timestamps, and no empty, loading, error or status states appear in the capture. [Mockup: SCR-012 · Observed]

## 6. Requirements Traceability

| REQ-001 | Managers approve or reject expense claims. | partially addressed | Approved: DEC-001 | DEC-001, DEC-002, FR-001, FR-002, FR-003; edge cases open (Q-001, Q-006, Q-007) |
| REQ-002 | Every approval and rejection must be recorded in an audit log. | partially addressed | Unknown | DEC-002, FR-008, FR-009; entry contents, retention, viewing, immutability open (Q-002 to Q-005) |
| REQ-003 | Finance staff can export the audit log. | partially addressed | Approved: DEC-003 | DEC-003, FR-012, FR-013; scope and other roles open (Q-002) |

## 7. Gaps Identified

| GAP-001 | Rejection reason capture not covered by the mockup | Approved: DEC-004 | research | critical | open (researched) | Reason is mandatory (DEC-002) but no capture point is shown; only general validation guidance found, WCAG question unanswered. |
| GAP-002 | Audit log entry contents, retention and integrity undefined | Approved: DEC-004 | research | critical | open (researched) | Generic fixture findings on fields, append-only and retention policy; customer answers needed (Q-003, Q-004, Q-005). |
| GAP-003 | Outcome of Approve and Reject not defined | Deferred: DEC-005 | both | critical | open (customer decision pending), deferred | Deferred by DEC-005; research not run. |

| GAP-007 | Export scope, columns and failure behaviour | Deferred: DEC-005 | both | important | open (customer decision pending), deferred | Deferred by DEC-005; research not run. |

| GAP-011 | Empty, loading and error states for both screens | Deferred: DEC-005 | customer | optional | open (customer decision pending), deferred | Deferred by DEC-005. |
| GAP-012 | Volume handling in claims list and audit log | Deferred: DEC-005 | customer | optional | open (customer decision pending), deferred | Deferred by DEC-005. |
| GAP-013 | Notification of the employee and downstream effects | Approved: DEC-005 | customer | optional | open (customer decision pending) | Approved; awaiting customer answer (Q-007). |
| GAP-014 | Time zone and date format of audit timestamps | Deferred: DEC-005 | both | optional | open (customer decision pending), deferred | Deferred by DEC-005; research not run. |
| GAP-015 | Navigation back from the Audit log | Deferred: DEC-005 | customer | optional | open (customer decision pending), deferred | Deferred by DEC-005. |

## 8. Functional Requirements

### Approving and rejecting claims

Purpose: a manager reviews pending claims from their direct reports and approves them or rejects them with a reason.

#### Confirmed requirements

- **FR-001** Managers approve claims from their own direct reports only, and can approve or reject expense claims. [Customer: REQ-001 · Approved: DEC-001] [Decision: DEC-001]
- **FR-002** Approve and Reject must be available to a manager only for expense claims submitted by that manager's own direct reports, for both seeing and acting on claims. Whether an amount limit also applies is not stated. [Customer: FEA-001 · Explicit] [Customer: REQ-001] [Decision: DEC-001]
- **FR-003** A claim cannot be rejected without a reason. Where the reason is entered, length or content rules, and whether the employee sees it are not decided. [Customer: FEA-005 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-002]

#### Recommendations awaiting approval

These are recommendations or research-supported practice drawn from a single low-confidence test-fixture source, not confirmed requirements.

- **FR-004** Recommendation: verify at the moment a decision is submitted that the acting manager is the claimant's direct manager, rather than relying only on which claims the list displays. [Inferred: FEA-003 · Recommended (awaiting approval)] [Decision: DEC-001]
- **FR-005** Recommendation: if the rejection reason is captured in a dialog or inline step, show the "reason required" message next to the reason field and keep any text already typed when validation fails. [Research: F-GAP-001-01 · Recommended (awaiting approval)] [Decision: DEC-002]
- **FR-006** Recommendation: enforce the mandatory rejection reason on the server as well as in the interface, so a reject request without a reason is refused. [Research: F-GAP-001-03 · Recommended (awaiting approval)] [Research: FEA-006] [Decision: DEC-002]
- **FR-007** Research-supported practice: an error on a field should not rely on colour alone and should include text naming the problem. Applied to the reason field this is an inference. [Research: F-GAP-001-02 · Research-supported] [Research: FEA-007]

#### Acceptance criteria

- **AC-001** Given a manager whose direct report Kim Lee has a pending claim EXP-77, When the manager approves EXP-77, Then the approval is accepted and an audit log entry is recorded for the decision; what the screen shows afterwards is not decided. [Customer: REQ-001 · Approved: DEC-001] [Decision: DEC-001]
- **AC-002** Given a manager whose direct report has a pending claim, When the manager rejects it and enters a reason such as "Receipt missing", Then the rejection is accepted and an audit log entry is recorded; where the reason is later visible is not decided. [Customer: REQ-001 · Approved: DEC-001] [Decision: DEC-002]
- **AC-003** Given a manager rejecting a claim, When the manager submits the rejection with the reason left empty, Then the rejection is not recorded and the claim remains undecided. Error wording is not decided. [Customer: FEA-005 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-002]
- **AC-004** Given a manager who is not the direct manager of the claimant, When that manager attempts to see, approve or reject the claim, Then the manager cannot act on it. [Customer: FEA-001 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-001]
- **AC-005** (draft) Given a reject request that bypasses the form and has no reason, When the request is processed, Then it is refused. [Research: F-GAP-001-03 · Recommended (awaiting approval)] [Research: FEA-006]
- **AC-006** (draft) Given the reason field is shown and empty, When the manager submits, Then text naming the problem appears next to the field and the problem is not indicated by colour alone. [Research: F-GAP-001-02 · Research-supported] [Research: F-GAP-001-01]

Behaviour that needs a decision and is not specified here: self-approval, claims with no eligible approver, absent managers and reporting-line changes (open question Q-001); reversal of decisions, duplicate or concurrent decisions, failure of an action, and empty, loading and error states (deferred, see Deferred).

### Audit log

Purpose: a record of every approval and rejection that managers and finance staff can rely on.

#### Confirmed requirements

- **FR-008** Each approval and each rejection must produce an audit log entry. [Customer: FEA-008 · Explicit] [Customer: REQ-002] [Decision: DEC-002]

#### Requirements with Unknown status

These are not confirmed requirements. They restate the customer's REQ-002, whose label is Unknown.

- **FR-009** The customer's requirement REQ-002 asks that approvals and rejections be recorded in an audit log; its entry contents, retention period and who may view the log are Unknown and undecided. [Customer: REQ-002 · Unknown] [Decision: DEC-002]

#### Recommendations awaiting approval

- **FR-010** Research-supported practice: an audit record for an approval decision should capture who acted, what was decided, when it happened, and the state before and after the change. Whether claim amount, employee and rejection reason are also recorded is undecided (Q-004). [Research: F-GAP-002-01 · Research-supported] [Research: FEA-009]
- **FR-011** Research-supported practice: audit records should be append-only so later edits cannot rewrite history. The customer has not decided whether any role may correct or remove entries (Q-003). [Research: F-GAP-002-02 · Research-supported] [Research: FEA-011]

#### Acceptance criteria

- **AC-007** Given a direct manager approves or rejects a claim, When the decision is accepted, Then the Audit log shows an entry for it with at least When, Who and Action, as in the mockup entry "2 Mar 10:14, J. Smith, Approved EXP-71". [Customer: FEA-008 · Explicit] [Mockup: SCR-012]
- **AC-008** (draft) Given an audit log entry exists, When any user tries to edit or delete it through the feature, Then the change is not possible. [Research: F-GAP-002-02 · Research-supported] [Research: FEA-011]

Behaviour that needs a decision: who may view the log, empty and error states, sorting and paging (see section 16 and Deferred).

### Audit log export

Purpose: finance staff take a working copy of approval history.

#### Confirmed requirements

- **FR-012** Finance staff can export the audit log. [Customer: REQ-003 · Approved: DEC-003] [Decision: DEC-003]
- **FR-013** Finance staff must be able to export audit log entries as a CSV file. What the file contains and who holds the export permission beyond finance staff are not decided. [Customer: FEA-013 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-003]

#### Recommendations awaiting approval

None. Information unavailable: no kept finding addresses the export.

#### Acceptance criteria

- **AC-009** Given a finance staff user on the Audit log screen, When the user selects Export CSV, Then the user receives a CSV file containing audit log entries; scope, columns and encoding are not decided. [Customer: REQ-003 · Approved: DEC-003] [Decision: DEC-003]

Behaviour that needs a decision, recorded as open question Q-002 and not chosen here: export by roles other than finance, and export failure and large-log behaviour (deferred).

## 9. State Transitions and Edge Cases

### Expense claim lifecycle

State names are not shown in the mockup (the approval status field is inferred, no status column is visible); "Pending" is used here as a label for a claim awaiting a decision.

| State | Event | Next state | Who can trigger | Provenance |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pending | Direct manager approves | Approved | Direct manager of the claimant | [Customer: REQ-001 · Approved: DEC-001] |
| Pending | Direct manager rejects with a reason | Rejected | Direct manager of the claimant | [Customer: FEA-005 · Explicit] |
| Pending | Reject submitted without a reason | Pending (refused) | Direct manager of the claimant | [Customer: FEA-005 · Explicit] |
| Pending | Non-direct-manager attempts a decision | Pending (refused) | Not permitted | [Customer: FEA-001 · Explicit] |
| Pending | Own-claim approval, no eligible approver, manager absent, or reporting line changes | Unknown | Unknown | [Inferred: FEA-002 · Unknown] |
| Approved | Decision reversed or corrected | Unknown | Unknown | [Assumption: ASM-G-001 · Assumption] |
| Rejected | Decision reversed or corrected | Unknown | Unknown | [Assumption: ASM-G-001 · Assumption] |

### Audit log entry lifecycle

| State | Event | Next state | Who can trigger | Provenance |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| (none) | Approval or rejection accepted | Recorded | System, on a manager's decision | [Customer: FEA-008 · Explicit] |
| Recorded | Edit or delete through the feature | Unknown (research suggests not permitted) | Unknown | [Research: FEA-011 · Research-supported] |
| Recorded | Retention period ends | Unknown | Unknown | [Inferred: FEA-012 · Unknown] |

## 10. Non-Functional Requirements

- **NFR-001** The retention period for audit records is set by the organisation's policy and not by the user interface; no period or jurisdiction has been supplied, so none is specified (Q-005). [Research: F-GAP-002-03 · Research-supported] [Inferred: FEA-012]

No performance, availability or compliance figures are stated because no input, decision or kept finding supplies them. Accessibility beyond FR-007 was not researched successfully: no WCAG 2.2 success criterion could be cited.

## 11. Data Model and Business Rules

Entities below come from the mockup only; no schema was inspected.

- Expense claim: visible fields Claim (reference and description), Employee, Amount; an approval status field is inferred, not visible. [Mockup: SCR-011 · Observed]
- Audit log entry: visible fields When, Who, Action. Additional fields (claim, amount, employee, reason, state before and after) are undecided. [Mockup: SCR-012 · Observed]
- Relationship: each approval or rejection produces one or more audit entries; whether exactly one is undecided.

- **BR-001** A rejection requires a reason. [Customer: FEA-005 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-002]
- **BR-002** A manager may approve or reject only claims submitted by their own direct reports. [Customer: FEA-001 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-001]
- **BR-003** The audit log is treated as covering approvals and rejections only, as REQ-002 states; logging of other events such as exports is not assumed. [Assumption: ASM-F-001 · Assumption] [Customer: REQ-002]

## 12. Screens and User Flows

- Expense approvals to Audit log via the Audit log link. [Mockup: SCR-007 · Observed]
- Approve, Reject and Export CSV have no destination in the capture; the flows after them are not defined. [Mockup: SCR-008 · Observed] [Mockup: SCR-009] [Mockup: SCR-010]
- No link back from the Audit log to Expense approvals is shown. [Mockup: SCR-007 · Observed]
- Where the rejection reason is entered (dialog or inline) is not defined in the mockup and is not chosen here. [Mockup: SCR-009 · Observed]

Design details intentionally left unspecified: reason entry placement, length rules and error wording; sorting, paging and default order; timestamp format and time zone.

## 13. Integrations and Dependencies

- Enforcing the direct-reports rule requires a source of each employee's manager; no supplied document identifies one and none is assumed (Q-006). [Inferred: FEA-004 · Unknown]
- Whether approval notifies the employee or starts payment or another process is not established. [Inferred: FEA-014 · Unknown]

## 14. Security, Privacy, and Error Handling

- Authority to decide should be checked when a decision is submitted (see FR-004). [Inferred: FEA-003 · Recommended (awaiting approval)]
- The mandatory reason should be refused server-side if missing (see FR-006). [Research: F-GAP-001-03 · Recommended (awaiting approval)]
- Who may view the audit log is undecided; the log contains names, amounts and decisions, and the Audit log link on the managers' screen does not confirm managers may view it. [Assumption: ASM-G-002 · Assumption]
- Error handling for failed actions and failed exports is not defined; see Deferred.

Stale items: none.

## 17. Research Findings and Recommendations

All findings below come from fixture sources that state they are test fixtures and not real documentation; confidence is low and none may be presented as authoritative.

- Validation messages should be shown next to the related field and user input kept when validation fails (SRC-2c9eb1bc). Recommendation, applied to the reason field by inference: show the "reason required" message beside the field and keep typed text. Limitation: general form guidance, nothing specific to reject-reason capture. [Research: F-GAP-001-01 · Recommended (awaiting approval)]
- An error state should not rely on colour alone and should include text naming the problem (SRC-2c9eb1bc). No WCAG success criterion is cited. [Research: F-GAP-001-02 · Research-supported]
- Required fields should be validated before submission and again on the server because client-side checks can be bypassed (SRC-2c9eb1bc). Recommendation: refuse a reject request with no reason on the server; applying it here is an inference. [Research: F-GAP-001-03 · Recommended (awaiting approval)]
- An approval audit record should capture who acted, what was decided, when, and the state before and after (SRC-24ac1554). Does not cover amount, employee or reason. [Research: F-GAP-002-01 · Research-supported]
- Audit records should be append-only (SRC-24ac1554). No techniques for tamper evidence are given. [Research: F-GAP-002-02 · Research-supported]
- Retention periods are set by the organisation's policy, not the user interface (SRC-24ac1554). No period or UK rule given; needs confirmation. [Research: F-GAP-002-03 · Research-supported]

### Limitations

No findings were dropped and none failed citation checks. Research questions that stayed unanswered, shown only to explain gaps in the research and not as evidence (also listed in section 16):

- Which WCAG 2.2 AA success criteria apply to a required reason field: no W3C source was available.
- Established patterns specific to reject-reason capture: only general form guidance was found.
- What OWASP and ISO 27001 recommend for approval audit records: neither was fetched.
- UK or HMRC retention periods: no matching source was found.
- Tamper-evidence techniques for audit logs: the only source gives the principle only.
- Research for deferred gaps was not run, by DEC-005.

1	# Expense Claim Approvals and Audit Log: Feature Specification
2	
3	## 1. Document Status
4	
5	- Run ID: 20261012-004104-3d33dd
6	- Date: 2026-10-12
7	- Run mode: fixture
8	- Publication status: pending final pass
9	- Known limitations: The mockup capture is complete (2 pages) but shows only one default row per screen and no empty, loading, error or success states. Research ran in fixture mode against two recorded sources that describe themselves as test fixtures, not real documentation; every kept finding has low confidence. No WCAG, OWASP, ISO 27001 or HMRC source could be fetched. Research was run only for the two gaps approved for research. Customer answers in this run are pre-written evaluation answers from a case file, not live customer replies. Review has not yet taken place.
10	- Open stale items: none
11	- Unresolved blocking issues: five blocking customer questions are unanswered (Q-001, Q-002, Q-003, Q-005, Q-006, see section 16); REQ-002 carries the label Unknown (audit entry contents, retention and viewing permissions undecided).
12	
13	## 2. Executive Summary
14	
15	Managers need to approve or reject expense claims, every approval and rejection must be written to an audit log, and finance staff need to export that log. The customer has confirmed that managers act only on claims from their own direct reports, that a reason is required when a claim is rejected, and that the export is a CSV file of audit log entries.
16	
17	This specification covers three areas: approving and rejecting claims, the audit log, and the CSV export. Several important points are still undecided and need customer answers before they can be built: what happens to claims from managers or when a manager is away, who may view the audit log, what each log entry must contain, whether log entries may ever be changed, how long they are kept, and where reporting lines are held. Many other gaps were deferred by decision and are listed under Deferred. The research that was done rests on weak test-fixture sources, so research-based items are shown as recommendations and not as confirmed requirements.
18	
19	## 3. Goals and Scope
20	
21	### Goals
22	
23	- Let managers approve or reject expense claims from their own direct reports. [Customer: REQ-001 · Approved: DEC-001] [Decision: DEC-001]
24	- Record every approval and rejection in an audit log. [Customer: FEA-008 · Explicit] [Customer: REQ-002]
25	- Let finance staff export the audit log as a CSV file. [Customer: REQ-003 · Approved: DEC-003] [Decision: DEC-003]
26

28	
29	- Approve and Reject actions limited to direct reports' claims. [Customer: FEA-001 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-001]
30	- A mandatory reason when rejecting a claim. [Customer: FEA-005 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-002]
31	- Audit log entries for approvals and rejections. [Customer: FEA-008 · Explicit]
32	- CSV export of audit log entries by finance staff. [Customer: FEA-013 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-003]
33	- Handling of the reject reason and the audit log contents is in scope as open design questions (GAP-001, GAP-002 approved by DEC-004), and the direct-reports edge cases and employee notification (GAP-004, GAP-013 approved by DEC-005) are in scope as open customer questions; their answers are not yet decided.
34	
35	### Out of Scope / Rejected
36	
37	No item has been rejected and no REQ was excluded by the customer. Information unavailable: no decision in this run records a rejection. Exclusions are not inferred from absence in the mockup.
38	
39	### Deferred

42	
43	- GAP-003 Outcome of Approve and Reject not defined. Label: Deferred: DEC-005
44	- GAP-005 Reversal or correction of a decision. Label: Deferred: DEC-005
45	- GAP-006 Who may view the audit log, and whether roles other than finance may export. Label: Deferred: DEC-005

57	- Manager: approves or rejects claims from their own direct reports only. [Customer: REQ-001 · Approved: DEC-001] [Decision: DEC-001]

59	- Employee: submits the claims shown (for example Kim Lee in the mockup). Whether employees are notified of outcomes is undecided. [Inferred: FEA-014 · Unknown]
60	- Roles that may view the audit log, roles other than finance that may export, and any administrator, delegate or override role are unknown and flagged as open questions (section 16). [Inferred: FEA-002 · Unknown]
61	- Who approves a manager's own claim or a top-level employee's claim is unknown. [Inferred: FEA-002 · Unknown]

[Mockup: SCR-003 · Observed]

104	## 8. Functional Requirements
105	
106	### Approving and rejecting claims
107	
108	Purpose: a manager reviews pending claims from their direct reports and approves them or rejects them with a reason.
109	
110	#### Confirmed requirements
111	
112	- **FR-001** Managers approve claims from their own direct reports only, and can approve or reject expense claims. [Customer: REQ-001 · Approved: DEC-001] [Decision: DEC-001]
113	- **FR-002** Approve and Reject must be available to a manager only for expense claims submitted by that manager's own direct reports, for both seeing and acting on claims. Whether an amount limit also applies is not stated. [Customer: FEA-001 · Explicit] [Customer: REQ-001] [Decision: DEC-001]
114	- **FR-003** A claim cannot be rejected without a reason. Where the reason is entered, length or content rules, and whether the employee sees it are not decided. [Customer: FEA-005 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-002]
115	
116	#### Recommendations awaiting approval
117	
118	These are recommendations or research-supported practice drawn from a single low-confidence test-fixture source, not confirmed requirements.
119	
120	- **FR-004** Recommendation: verify at the moment a decision is submitted that the acting manager is the claimant's direct manager, rather than relying only on which claims the list displays. [Inferred: FEA-003 · Recommended (awaiting approval)] [Decision: DEC-001]
121	- **FR-005** Recommendation: if the rejection reason is captured in a dialog or inline step, show the "reason required" message next to the reason field and keep any text already typed when validation fails. [Research: F-GAP-001-01 · Recommended (awaiting approval)] [Decision: DEC-002]
122	- **FR-006** Recommendation: enforce the mandatory rejection reason on the server as well as in the interface, so a reject request without a reason is refused. [Research: F-GAP-001-03 · Recommended (awaiting approval)] [Research: FEA-006] [Decision: DEC-002]
123	- **FR-007** Research-supported practice: an error on a field should not rely on colour alone and should include text naming the problem. Applied to the reason field this is an inference. [Research: F-GAP-001-02 · Research-supported] [Research: FEA-007]
124	
125	#### Acceptance criteria
126	
127	- **AC-001** Given a manager whose direct report Kim Lee has a pending claim EXP-77, When the manager approves EXP-77, Then the approval is accepted and an audit log entry is recorded for the decision; what the screen shows afterwards is not decided. [Customer: REQ-001 · Approved: DEC-001] [Decision: DEC-001]
128	- **AC-002** Given a manager whose direct report has a pending claim, When the manager rejects it and enters a reason such as "Receipt missing", Then the rejection is accepted and an audit log entry is recorded; where the reason is later visible is not decided. [Customer: REQ-001 · Approved: DEC-001] [Decision: DEC-002]
129	- **AC-003** Given a manager rejecting a claim, When the manager submits the rejection with the reason left empty, Then the rejection is not recorded and the claim remains undecided. Error wording is not decided. [Customer: FEA-005 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-002]
130	- **AC-004** Given a manager who is not the direct manager of the claimant, When that manager attempts to see, approve or reject the claim, Then the manager cannot act on it. [Customer: FEA-001 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-001]
131	- **AC-005** (draft) Given a reject request that bypasses the form and has no reason, When the request is processed, Then it is refused. [Research: F-GAP-001-03 · Recommended (awaiting approval)] [Research: FEA-006]
132	- **AC-006** (draft) Given the reason field is shown and empty, When the manager submits, Then text naming the problem appears next to the field and the problem is not indicated by colour alone. [Research: F-GAP-001-02 · Research-supported] [Research: F-GAP-001-01]

280	## 17. Research Findings and Recommendations
281	
282	All findings below come from fixture sources that state they are test fixtures and not real documentation; confidence is low and none may be presented as authoritative.
283	
284	- Validation messages should be shown next to the related field and user input kept when validation fails (SRC-2c9eb1bc). Recommendation, applied to the reason field by inference: show the "reason required" message beside the field and keep typed text. Limitation: general form guidance, nothing specific to reject-reason capture. [Research: F-GAP-001-01 · Recommended (awaiting approval)]
285	- An error state should not rely on colour alone and should include text naming the problem (SRC-2c9eb1bc). No WCAG success criterion is cited. [Research: F-GAP-001-02 · Research-supported]
286	- Required fields should be validated before submission and again on the server because client-side checks can be bypassed (SRC-2c9eb1bc). Recommendation: refuse a reject request with no reason on the server; applying it here is an inference. [Research: F-GAP-001-03 · Recommended (awaiting approval)]
287	- An approval audit record should capture who acted, what was decided, when, and the state before and after (SRC-24ac1554). Does not cover amount, employee or reason. [Research: F-GAP-002-01 · Research-supported]
288	- Audit records should be append-only (SRC-24ac1554). No techniques for tamper evidence are given. [Research: F-GAP-002-02 · Research-supported]
289	- Retention periods are set by the organisation's policy, not the user interface (SRC-24ac1554). No period or UK rule given; needs confirmation. [Research: F-GAP-002-03 · Research-supported]

# Expense Claim Approvals and Audit Log: Feature Specification

## 1. Document Status

- Run ID: 20261012-004104-3d33dd
- Date: 2026-10-12
- Run mode: fixture
- Publication status: eval_only
- Known limitations: The mockup capture is complete (2 pages) but shows only one default row per screen and no empty, loading, error or success states. Research ran in fixture mode against two recorded sources that describe themselves as test fixtures, not real documentation; every kept finding has low confidence. No WCAG, OWASP, ISO 27001 or HMRC source could be fetched. Research was run only for the two gaps approved for research. Customer answers in this run are pre-written evaluation answers from a case file, not live customer replies. Review passed in round 2 with a warning on item 21. Fixture mode always gives the publication status eval_only, so this specification is for evaluation only.
- Open stale items: none
- Unresolved blocking issues: five blocking customer questions are unanswered (Q-001, Q-002, Q-003, Q-005, Q-006, see section 16); REQ-002 carries the label Unknown (audit entry contents, retention and viewing permissions undecided). The review reports no unresolved issues. Seven customer questions in total are outstanding (Q-001 to Q-007).

## 2. Executive Summary

Managers need to approve or reject expense claims, every approval and rejection must be written to an audit log, and finance staff need to export that log. The customer has confirmed that managers act only on claims from their own direct reports, that a reason is required when a claim is rejected, and that the export is a CSV file of audit log entries.

This specification covers three areas: approving and rejecting claims, the audit log, and the CSV export. Several important points are still undecided and need customer answers before they can be built: what happens to claims from managers or when a manager is away, who may view the audit log, what each log entry must contain, whether log entries may ever be changed, how long they are kept, and where reporting lines are held. Many other gaps were deferred by decision and are listed under Deferred. The research that was done rests on weak test-fixture sources, so research-based items are shown as recommendations and not as confirmed requirements.

## 3. Goals and Scope

### Goals

- Let managers approve or reject expense claims from their own direct reports. [Customer: REQ-001 · Approved: DEC-001] [Decision: DEC-001]
- Record every approval and rejection in an audit log. [Customer: FEA-008 · Explicit] [Customer: REQ-002]
- Let finance staff export the audit log as a CSV file. [Customer: REQ-003 · Approved: DEC-003] [Decision: DEC-003]

### In Scope

- Approve and Reject actions limited to direct reports' claims. [Customer: FEA-001 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-001]
- A mandatory reason when rejecting a claim. [Customer: FEA-005 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-002]
- Audit log entries for approvals and rejections. [Customer: FEA-008 · Explicit]
- CSV export of audit log entries by finance staff. [Customer: FEA-013 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-003]
- Handling of the reject reason and the audit log contents is in scope as open design questions (GAP-001, GAP-002 approved by DEC-004), and the direct-reports edge cases and employee notification (GAP-004, GAP-013 approved by DEC-005) are in scope as open customer questions; their answers are not yet decided.

### Out of Scope / Rejected

No item has been rejected and no REQ was excluded by the customer. Information unavailable: no decision in this run records a rejection. Exclusions are not inferred from absence in the mockup.

### Deferred

Deferred by DEC-005 (research for these gaps was not run). Each is listed with its label; none is specified in this document.

- GAP-003 Outcome of Approve and Reject not defined. Label: Deferred: DEC-005
- GAP-005 Reversal or correction of a decision. Label: Deferred: DEC-005
- GAP-006 Who may view the audit log, and whether roles other than finance may export. Label: Deferred: DEC-005
- GAP-007 Export scope, columns and failure behaviour. Label: Deferred: DEC-005
- GAP-008 Spreadsheet formula injection through exported CSV. Label: Deferred: DEC-005
- GAP-009 Duplicate and concurrent decisions on the same claim. Label: Deferred: DEC-005
- GAP-010 Accessible names and feedback for row actions. Label: Deferred: DEC-005
- GAP-011 Empty, loading and error states for both screens. Label: Deferred: DEC-005
- GAP-012 Volume handling in claims list and audit log. Label: Deferred: DEC-005
- GAP-014 Time zone and date format of audit timestamps. Label: Deferred: DEC-005
- GAP-015 Navigation back from the Audit log. Label: Deferred: DEC-005

## 4. Users and Roles

- Manager: approves or rejects claims from their own direct reports only. [Customer: REQ-001 · Approved: DEC-001] [Decision: DEC-001]
- Finance staff: can export the audit log. [Customer: REQ-003 · Approved: DEC-003]
- Employee: submits the claims shown (for example Kim Lee in the mockup). Whether employees are notified of outcomes is undecided. [Inferred: FEA-014 · Unknown]
- Roles that may view the audit log, roles other than finance that may export, and any administrator, delegate or override role are unknown and flagged as open questions (section 16). [Inferred: FEA-002 · Unknown]
- Who approves a manager's own claim or a top-level employee's claim is unknown. [Inferred: FEA-002 · Unknown]

## 5. Existing Mockup Coverage

Capture status: complete, 2 pages captured, 0 failed, fixture mode.

- Screen "Expense approvals": table of claims (Claim, Employee, Amount) with Approve and Reject buttons per row and an Audit log link; default state shows one row (EXP-77 Train to Leeds, Kim Lee, £86.40). [Mockup: SCR-001 · Observed]

[Mockup: SCR-003 · Observed]

## 8. Functional Requirements

### Approving and rejecting claims

Purpose: a manager reviews pending claims from their direct reports and approves them or rejects them with a reason.

#### Confirmed requirements

- **FR-001** Managers approve claims from their own direct reports only, and can approve or reject expense claims. [Customer: REQ-001 · Approved: DEC-001] [Decision: DEC-001]
- **FR-002** Approve and Reject must be available to a manager only for expense claims submitted by that manager's own direct reports, for both seeing and acting on claims. Whether an amount limit also applies is not stated. [Customer: FEA-001 · Explicit] [Customer: REQ-001] [Decision: DEC-001]
- **FR-003** A claim cannot be rejected without a reason. Where the reason is entered, length or content rules, and whether the employee sees it are not decided. [Customer: FEA-005 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-002]

#### Recommendations awaiting approval

These are recommendations or research-supported practice drawn from a single low-confidence test-fixture source, not confirmed requirements.

- **FR-004** Recommendation: verify at the moment a decision is submitted that the acting manager is the claimant's direct manager, rather than relying only on which claims the list displays. [Inferred: FEA-003 · Recommended (awaiting approval)] [Decision: DEC-001]
- **FR-005** Recommendation: if the rejection reason is captured in a dialog or inline step, show the "reason required" message next to the reason field and keep any text already typed when validation fails. [Research: F-GAP-001-01 · Recommended (awaiting approval)] [Decision: DEC-002]
- **FR-006** Recommendation: enforce the mandatory rejection reason on the server as well as in the interface, so a reject request without a reason is refused. [Research: F-GAP-001-03 · Recommended (awaiting approval)] [Research: FEA-006] [Decision: DEC-002]
- **FR-007** Research-supported practice: an error on a field should not rely on colour alone and should include text naming the problem. Applied to the reason field this is an inference. [Research: F-GAP-001-02 · Research-supported] [Research: FEA-007]

#### Acceptance criteria

- **AC-001** Given a manager whose direct report Kim Lee has a pending claim EXP-77, When the manager approves EXP-77, Then the approval is accepted and an audit log entry is recorded for the decision; what the screen shows afterwards is not decided. [Customer: REQ-001 · Approved: DEC-001] [Decision: DEC-001]
- **AC-002** Given a manager whose direct report has a pending claim, When the manager rejects it and enters a reason such as "Receipt missing", Then the rejection is accepted and an audit log entry is recorded; where the reason is later visible is not decided. [Customer: REQ-001 · Approved: DEC-001] [Decision: DEC-002]
- **AC-003** Given a manager rejecting a claim, When the manager submits the rejection with the reason left empty, Then the rejection is not recorded and the claim remains undecided. Error wording is not decided. [Customer: FEA-005 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-002]
- **AC-004** Given a manager who is not the direct manager of the claimant, When that manager attempts to see, approve or reject the claim, Then the manager cannot act on it. [Customer: FEA-001 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-001]
- **AC-005** (draft) Given a reject request that bypasses the form and has no reason, When the request is processed, Then it is refused. [Research: F-GAP-001-03 · Recommended (awaiting approval)] [Research: FEA-006]
- **AC-006** (draft) Given the reason field is shown and empty, When the manager submits, Then text naming the problem appears next to the field and the problem is not indicated by colour alone. [Research: F-GAP-001-02 · Research-supported] [Research: F-GAP-001-01]

Behaviour that needs a decision and is not specified here: self-approval, claims with no eligible approver, absent managers and reporting-line changes (open question Q-001); reversal of decisions, duplicate or concurrent decisions, failure of an action, and empty, loading and error states (deferred, see Deferred).

### Audit log

Purpose: a record of every approval and rejection that managers and finance staff can rely on.

#### Confirmed requirements

- **FR-008** Each approval and each rejection must produce an audit log entry. [Customer: FEA-008 · Explicit] [Customer: REQ-002] [Decision: DEC-002]

#### Requirements with Unknown status

These are not confirmed requirements. They restate the customer's REQ-002, whose label is Unknown.

- **FR-009** The customer's requirement REQ-002 asks that approvals and rejections be recorded in an audit log; its entry contents, retention period and who may view the log are Unknown and undecided. [Customer: REQ-002 · Unknown] [Decision: DEC-002]

#### Recommendations awaiting approval

- **FR-010** Research-supported practice: an audit record for an approval decision should capture who acted, what was decided, when it happened, and the state before and after the change. Whether claim amount, employee and rejection reason are also recorded is undecided (Q-004). [Research: F-GAP-002-01 · Research-supported] [Research: FEA-009]
- **FR-011** Research-supported practice: audit records should be append-only so later edits cannot rewrite history. The customer has not decided whether any role may correct or remove entries (Q-003). [Research: F-GAP-002-02 · Research-supported] [Research: FEA-011]

#### Acceptance criteria

- **AC-007** Given a direct manager approves or rejects a claim, When the decision is accepted, Then the Audit log shows an entry for it with at least When, Who and Action, as in the mockup entry "2 Mar 10:14, J. Smith, Approved EXP-71". [Customer: FEA-008 · Explicit] [Mockup: SCR-012]
- **AC-008** (draft) Given an audit log entry exists, When any user tries to edit or delete it through the feature, Then the change is not possible. [Research: F-GAP-002-02 · Research-supported] [Research: FEA-011]

#### Confirmed requirements

- **FR-013** Finance staff must be able to export audit log entries as a CSV file. What the file contains and who holds the export permission beyond finance staff are not decided. [Customer: FEA-013 · Explicit] [Decision: DEC-003]

None. Information unavailable: no kept finding addresses the export.
